idea-plugin.name: Blood, Sweat and Code
idea-plugin.description:
A cheerful pastel-purple coding companion for ARMY. Fan-made, not affiliated with HYBE or BTS.

It keeps track of your day:

  • Sweat: keystrokes typed today
  • Blood: bugs squashed (the error count in a file you're editing goes down)
  • Code: lines you wrote today, against a daily goal

While you code you get pixel hearts when typing, a "7" burst when deleting, sparkles on new lines, fan-edit sound clips, confetti when you hit your goal, and easter eggs when you type words like borahae, army or dynamite.

Everything lives in a small tool window on the right and a status bar counter. Calm mode turns off all effects and sound while your counts keep going.
